## Brief

- Core message: CodeGrind now blends LeetCode-style challenges with an Azure OpenAI-powered assistant, offering step-by-step hints, model switching, and real-time code evaluation to help users learn DS&A more interactively.
- CTA: Try a guided practice session with AI assistance today.
- Visual brief: A short, cinematic demo: a split-screen showing the CodeGrind editor on one side with a problem prompt, and the AI assistant providing hints and code suggestions on the other. Include subtle cyberpunk UI cues, live code execution results, and a quick animation of a problem being solved from hint to final solution.
